description:
Standalone Windows editor for AutoCAD Sheet Set (.dst) properties and mapped CSV or TSV updates.

Sheet Set Editor is a standalone Windows application for working with AutoCAD Sheet Set .dst data. It displays sheet sets, subsets and sheets in a tree and lets users edit supported sheet-set, sheet and custom properties without keeping AutoCAD open. Users can import mapped CSV or TSV data across multiple sheets, review the result and save with an automatic backup and validation before every write. The application is intended for AutoCAD Sheet Set .dst files, not embroidery-machine DST files. An optional integration is available for AutoCAD 2027.
BoekSolutions Sheet Set Batch Editor 1.3.1 (2026-10-22)
- Fixed: the installed app reports the correct version and no longer offers the same update again.
- Added: keep multiple sheet sets open and switch between them through Open documents in the file menu, with one sheet set in the foreground.
- Added: open several sheet sets at once; each keeps its own selection, expanded tree and unsaved changes.
- Fixed: the AutoCAD launcher uses the sheet set selected in Sheet Set Manager instead of choosing the first opened sheet set.
- Fixed: closing the editor checks all modified open sheet sets before exiting.
- Improved: clearer menu hover highlights in Book, Light and Dark themes, with a contrasting outline.
- Improved: updated Dutch and English offline instructions for working with multiple sheet sets.
Windows 10/11 x64. Optional integration targets Autodesk AutoCAD 2027.
